profile.identityNoteJa: ここではレビ人の氏族名としての「メラリの子ら」を扱い、族祖個人の伝記を示すものではありません。

facts.textJa: ヨシヤの時代、メラリの子らから監督者が挙げられました。

wikipedia.title: Merari
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事はメラリをレビの子、メラリ人の祖と説明します。ここで記される「メラリの子ら」という氏族名との関係を示す参考です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Then the Levites arose: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.
